completeness.expectedCountMethod: Request a limit above the population, require fewer rows than the limit, and compare the rendered Agentic Coding rows with the first 100 API rows.
completeness.pagination: limit query parameter; the page renders the first 100 rows

notes: Agentic Coding GScore only (2026-11-21 user decision); combined, one-shot and decision-making scores are preserved in raw evidence.
GScore is relative and rebalanced as models and games are added; no benchmark version is published.
No effort, reasoning or harness setting is published per row; these remain null.
Exact catalog display names and aliases resolve existing model identities; baseline and human rows are excluded.
